payload.title: Claims held over the per-change cap still reach the judges: the cycle's judgment lane samples every raw row of every registered tool and neither the sampler nor the fan-out reads change_review_budget_held or change_review_claim_admitted, so claims_per_change bounds only governance rows
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_funnel.py:736-744 (_admitted_claim_ids is the only reader of the admitted rows and is called by admit_change_claims itself)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_funnel.py:786-807 (admit_change_claims writes the admitted and held rows and returns the split)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:401-412 (the bridge keeps only the counts of the split; every sound claim is already a raw row)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1841-1883 (_sampleable_raw_findings filters status, recency, feedback, settled fingerprints and quarantine, never held or admitted)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:2098-2113 (the judgment phase calls generate_judgment_sample for every registered tool, change-review included)
payload.rule_violated: The per-change cap bounds the claims that enter proof (judgment_funnel module docstring WP-D4; change_review.py docstring: at most the policy's number of claims enter proof)
payload.notes: Twenty claims bridged for one change give 8 admitted and 12 held rows, but all 20 are raw findings of the tool change-review. The next judgment phase samples them (the D3 reviewer's probe: 20 sample items, 12 of them held claims) and dispatch_judges_for_sample mints judge requests for held claims, so the cap that is meant to bound proof spend per change does not bound the only consumer that exists. Traced here by reading; the held rows have a writer and no reader. Close condition: Make the held and admitted rows the sampler's filter: _sampleable_raw_findings (or route_judgment_sample for every tool) skips a claim whose fingerprint has a change_review_budget_held row and no admitted row. Test: after bridging 20 claims, generate_judgment_sample for change-review contains only the 8 admitted fingerprints. Plan row: D3 (program finding ARIA-MEDIUM-761). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
